purpose: Confirm across seeds 47 and 71 whether the Stage5 L5 failure is primarily a 4B-to-1.7B representation/dictionary mismatch, using scale-matched 1.7B surrogate ancestry fields while leaving the existing KD students unchanged.
targets: existing Stage5 Qwen3-1.7B Mixture-KD students for seeds 47 and 71; no student retraining

surrogate_experts.data: exact frozen formal domain training JSONL used for the original controlled experts
surrogate_experts.recipe: same v0.11 QLoRA recipe: r16 alpha32 dropout0.05, all Q/K/V/O and MLP projections, 1 epoch, batch1 x grad_accum16, lr2e-4, cosine, prompt-masked response loss

measurement: existing deterministic Stage5 per-seed audit union and frozen Stage3 Active-B32 / Random-B32 selections; greedy max_new_tokens=96; all-mpnet-base-v2

multiseed_gate.action_if_pass: treat cross-scale mismatch as replicated diagnostic evidence; design and test a frozen scale-aware representation/bridge on the actual 4B->1.7B lineage before any L7 run
multiseed_gate.action_if_fail: stop training scale-matched surrogate experts; revise the functional representation/decomposition before any L7 run

guardrails: Seed-23 Stage5E artifacts are reference-only and must not be retrained.
The 1.7B sibling experts are diagnostic surrogates, not the true genealogical 4B teachers.
No Stage4 matched-G0 finite-sample calibration transfers to this G1 diagnostic.
Teacher exposure weights are construction metadata, not functional-coordinate ground truth.
Do not alter Stage1-5 original run roots/results and do not enter L7 solely because this diagnostic passes.
